product_metadata.title: Ameriwood Home Owen Retro Student Desk, Weathered Oak
features: Ameriwood Home Owen Retro Student Desk creates usable space, even in small rooms
The slim profile is not only perfectly sized for a desk, but this versatile piece can also be used as a vanity or console table with the added bonus of a drawer and a wire management grommet
Simple assembly required. Dimensions: 30"h x 41.9"w x 21"d. Shipping weight is approximately 55.22 lbs
Neutral white finish with a light distressed brown drawer front brings an updated style to your décor
Laminated MDF with powder-coated metal legs and handles
description: Simplicity and functionality come together in the Ameriwood Home Owen Retro Student Desk. The slender silhouette allows the Owen Desk to easily fit in small spaces. The Desk features ultra-slim, yet sturdy Black metal hairpin legs and a large desk top in a crisp White finish. A light brown Oak storage drawer provides plenty of room for all your writing and office materials with its 3 drawer dividers and the desk top grommet ensures that your cords are tangle-free. This simple design not only looks great but it is easy to assemble, too. Ameriwood Home Owen Retro Desk requires minimal assembly upon delivery.

details.Product Care Instructions: Dust and wipe with a dry cloth and if needed, a damp cloth may be used sparingly.
